title: Wife's wedding ring moved and found by prayer

tellings.quote: So, her wedding ring was actually moved.

plain: Brandon Fugal, owner of a Utah property called Skinwalker Ranch that is known for strange reports, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that around 2024 his wife Kristen's wedding ring was moved at their home. As he relays it, the ring was found again through prayer, which would mean the strangeness is not limited to the ranch.
